title: AIRMO drone telemetry system
summary: Methane data sent from a UAV over an RF telemetry link to a ground-station display.
overview: Methane measurements are received by the UAV and transmitted over an RF telemetry link. The ground station receives the data and displays it for monitoring.
components: Methane measurement data as the telemetry input.
UAV receiving and transmitting the measurements.
RF telemetry link between UAV and ground station.
Ground-station display for the received data.

diagram.alt: Methane measurements enter the UAV, travel over RF telemetry, and are displayed by the ground station.
